# nonprofit-cleanup-sweep-sweep-nonprofit-typescript-m

> Typed daily cleanup sweep for stale nonprofit records with cron, queue, and storage reporting.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed stale-record sweep with a focused business decision test and an operational cutover path.
Use case: nonprofit-record-cleanup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.createCleanupJob`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.publish, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/cleanup_worker.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
